legalEntity: TODAQ Micro Inc., doing business as Qatom
endorsement: Powered by TODAQ Labs Core IP

assetRepository.status: PLACEHOLDER — confirm repo URL and access before publishing
assetRepository.note: Single source of truth for humans and agents. Read brand-for-ai.md + brand-spec.json for rules, then fetch assets by path via assets.json.

positioning.hero: Turn your APIs into payable agentic storefronts.
positioning.descriptor: The all-in-one sovereign commerce platform for AI — a headless agentic market and payment rail.
positioning.masterBrandRule: Qatom owns 100% of commercial surfaces; TODAQ Labs appears only as an endorsement.

colour.principle: Neutral-first, cool only. No beige anywhere in a background (only warmth is in photography). Verdigris is the signature accent, not a field. Mist/oxide/pine are cool variance grounds.

never: flood a surface with saturated teal/green
white running text on verdigris (logo-strength only)

colour.inspiration: Sampled from sky and water — fintech conscious of planet and people.

wordmark.use: wordmark artwork only (use the supplied vector, never retype)

anatomy.circle: the fortress — deterministic console holding assets and wallets
anatomy.travellingPiece: the payout / split / agent twin (proxy) that transacts across the wider ecosystem
anatomy.strike: the transaction — value settling in one decisive pass

construction.unit: M = the mark's height (the mark is square, so M is also its width)
construction.basis: measured from master vector: mark 245.9×245.3u, wordmark 701.9u wide, gap 50.1u
construction.note: Ratios read off the supplied artwork; scale the master, never retype to hit these numbers.

graphicDevice.name: the strike, extended
graphicDevice.meaning: the mark's strike (the transaction) pulled out as a line; arc echoes the travelling piece
rules: belongs to the mark, never a free diagonal
never boxed, over photography, or duplicated

voice.principle: Compress the consequence, not the science. Verified, not trusted.
voice.balance: Digital ⟷ Organic — the apex of the digital and the organic; never at an extreme.

layout.surfaces: frosted-glass cards, hairline borders, crisp finishes
layout.buttons: pill; verdigris fill (primary), near-black, or white ghost
layout.grid: single column, wide margins; the diagonal (strike) runs at -40.66°
layout.motion: the 260ms Strike — one decisive token; slides advance by fade + slight horizontal slide

spelling: Always "Qatom" — never all-caps in body, never Qat0m.
forAgents: When generating any Qatom asset (deck, social post, web element, icon): use a cool neutral ground, exactly one verdigris accent, the type trio (Source Serif 4 display / Hanken Grotesk text / IBM Plex Mono labels), the untouched mark, and the voice above. No beige, no code-speak in brand copy, no Web3 hype.
